reasonConventions.symmetry: { code: 'not-a-symmetry', nodes: positions i (increasing) for which some j has C[tau[i]][tau[j]] != C[i][j] }
reasonConventions.condition_1: { code: 'not-an-involution', nodes: positions i with tau[tau[i]] != i } when tau^2 != 1 (takes precedence); else { code: 'moves-black-set', nodes: black positions i with tau[i] white }
reasonConventions.condition_2: { code: 'differs-from-minus-wX', nodes: black positions i with w_X(e_i) != -e_tau(i) }
reasonConventions.condition_3: { code: 'not-an-integer', nodes: white tau-fixed positions with non-integer <alpha_i, rho_X^vee>, value: ratToString of the fraction; with several nodes the fractions in node order joined by '; ' }
reasonConventions.general: an entry only for each failed item, keys in the order symmetry, condition_1, condition_2, condition_3; nodes are positions (convert with toLabels); value only on not-an-integer

handoff: For P6-A2: satake returns restricted_board 'B2' for every rank 2 system with two lengths and lists restricted_orbits_in_bourbaki_order in identify's order. The C2 renaming and reversal are satakeRecord's. satake_examples is already registered, and restrictedBoard(d).board carries labels in Bourbaki order. For P6-A3: admissibility never throws on a well-formed permutation of a finite board. satake and restrictedBoard throw NotAdmissible with the Admissibility in data and the message 'not admissible: <first failed key>'. Composite words are played left to right on populations with applyWord(board, p, word, 'mutation'), and shadow2 returns doubled shadows; write the reason sentences from reasonConventions.
